title: CARE-WM: Same-Horizon Self-Conditioning with Constraint-Adaptive Regularization for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning with latent world models requires both accurate multi-step predictions and latent distances that reflect physical proximity to the goal. However, models are typically trained on ground-truth observations but must rely on their own imaginations during planning, while closer latent distances do not necessarily correspond to better task outcomes. Existing methods resort to auxiliary training objectives or additional task-cost readouts, which respectively incur extra training overhead or leave the latent geometry itself misaligned with task cost. We introduce CARE-WM, a drop-in training method that meets both requirements without additional supervision, a separate cost model, or any change to LeWM's architecture and Euclidean-cost planner. CARE-WM trains the predictor on its own predictions and adaptively calibrates the strength of latent regularization. With a single hyperparameter configuration, CARE-WM improves mean planning succ

translated_title: CARE-WM：面向潜在世界模型的同视界自条件化与约束自适应正则化
translated_abstract: 基于潜在世界模型的规划既需要准确的多步预测，也需要能反映与目标物理接近程度的潜在距离。然而，模型通常在真实观测上训练，但在规划时必须依赖自身的想象，而更近的潜在距离并不一定对应更好的任务结果。现有方法依赖辅助训练目标或额外的任务代价读出模块，前者会带来额外训练开销，后者则使潜在几何结构本身仍与任务代价不对齐。我们提出CARE-WM，这是一种即插即用的训练方法，无需额外监督、无需独立的代价模型，也无需改变LeWM的架构和欧氏代价规划器即可同时满足上述两项要求。CARE-WM在预测器自身的预测上进行训练，并自适应地校准潜在正则化的强度。仅需单一超参数配置，CARE-WM即可提升平均规划成功率（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: CARE-WM通过同视界自条件化训练与约束自适应的潜在正则化，在无需额外监督、独立代价模型或架构改动的情况下，同时提升潜在世界模型的多步预测精度和潜在空间与任务代价的对齐程度，从而提高规划成功率。
